resume.headline: CHIEF OPERATING OFFICER
resume.summary: Strategic Planning/Management Strong communication skills Strong credit/financial analysis skills Team builder/collaborator Sales management Negotiation skills Strong multi-tasker Project management Planning/execution Cross Functional leadership

work.title: Chief Operating Officer
bullets: Recruited by the Board of Directors to become COO.

Oversaw all aspects of this 35+ year old medical practice comprised of 5 freestanding radiation oncology clinics located in the South Puget Sound with 8 physicians (6 whom are owners) and 64 employees.
Revenues grew from $48MM in 2008 to over $53MM in 2014.
Saved the company over $160,000 in 2015 due to hard negotiations with our Electronic Medical Record vendor due to poor performance.
Saved the company over $120,000 annually by negotiating with the bank to lower interest rates on loans in early 2009.
Brought two construction projects, one for a new clinic with a $6.5MM budget and the other for an extensive remodel with a $4.5MM budget, under budget and on time saving $200,000 in total.
Brought in a consultant to successfully turn the Board Meetings into efficient, professional meetings with strict agendas, time allotments for each topic and rules of order.
Oversaw the opening of and addition of a Urology practice as well as the first mobile Brachytherapy unit in the State of WA (for the treatment of various types of cancer).
Successfully negotiated with two of the owners for buyouts on behalf of the Board.

work.title: Vice President and Commercial Banker
bullets: Recruited by and joined as Vice President and Commercial Banker with no loan portfolio 05/1998
Through aggressive sales calls/marketing, grew portfolio to over $30MM in outstandings and $50MM in commitments in three years!
Promoted to SVP due to growth of portfolio and fee income/referrals 06/2001
Promoted to SVP and SWWA Commercial Banking Manager 06/2003
Responsible for 8 commercial middle market lenders, whose territory stretched from Auburn to Longview, WA.
Overall TEAM portfolio grew from outstandings of $100MM to over $160MM in a highly competitive, charged environment.
Implemented monthly sales meetings to emphasize consistent marketing and calling efforts, both with prospects and in cross-selling to existing customers.
Was asked to join Loan Committee as a voting member. June 2005
Part of an assigned team to perform due diligence on potential bank purchases.
